title: Steering Away From Misalignment: Can a Single Direction Inoculate a Fine-Tune?

original_idea.body:
# Steering Away From Misalignment

**Problem:** Whether subtracting the misaligned-persona direction reduces EM without wrecking capability is open.

**Direction:** Extract the misaligned-persona direction from an EM organism, subtract it at inference at varying strengths, measure misalignment vs benign accuracy.

**Why it matters:** A pure inference-time steering defense for open-weight deployers.

**Relevant context:** arXiv:2506.19823; arXiv:2507.21509.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Inference-time steering defense against EM with a defensible chain to deployable mitigation.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Activation steering with difference-of-means is intermediate; clear inherited method.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused steering-strength sweep; depends on an EM organism and activation tooling.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Public EM organisms; lab-independent inference-time defense work.

low_compute.reasoning: Inference plus reusing an existing organism; one GPU.

novelty.reasoning: Persona-direction steering shown; the inoculation/sweet-spot framing partly extends it.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Steering along the direction shown; systematic defense characterization may be open.
